message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**Apple's total net sales for fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024): $391,035 million** (~$391.0B), up 2% from $383,285 million in fiscal 2023.

Supporting figures from the 10-K that informed the decision:
- Services net sales $96,169M, +13% YoY, with services gross margin of 73.9% — the main growth and margin engine.
- Total gross margin $201.0B... precisely $180,683M, gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%).
- Operating income $123,216M (+8%); operating cash flow $118,254M.
- Net income $93,736M and diluted EPS $6.08, both down YoY solely because of a one-time $10.2B net tax charge tied to the EC State Aid Decision (effective tax rate 24.1% vs 14.7%); pre-tax income actually rose to $123,485M.
- Balance sheet strength: $140.8B unrestricted cash and marketable securities; $95.0B of stock repurchased in FY24.
- Watch items: Greater China net sales fell 8% to $66,952M; iPhone roughly flat at $201,183M; ongoing DOJ/EU DMA antitrust exposure.

**What I did:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (filed 2024-11-01), checked the live quote (last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72), and placed a single buy limit order for **40 shares of AAPL at $222.90** — a limit just above the ask to ensure a fill, and well within "close to market." The order filled at $222.90 for a total of **$8,916**, satisfying the mandate: AAPL only, buy only, under the $10,000 per-order cap, and total same-day purchases of $8,916 are under the $20,000 daily cap. No funds were moved out of the account (cash was $50,000; the existing 100 MSFT shares were left untouched). The rationale: modest but positive top-line growth driven by high-margin Services, expanding gross margin, strong operating cash flow, and a depressed net income figure that reflects a non-recurring tax item rather than operating deterioration — a favorable setup for a long position, with Greater China weakness and regulatory risk as the main caveats.

Order filled at 222.90, 40 shares = $8,916. Under $10k per order, total today $8,916 < $20,000. No transfers.

Summary paragraph.
